summary: Tested all 10 requested features for FTC wallet transfer and mining. All features working correctly: wallet verification (valid/invalid), Send FTC transfers, balance updates, global ledger entries, AI Boost (5s 2x), Refresh Mining Data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All wallet transfer features working. Wallet verification requires 20+ character address to trigger API call. Valid wallet shows green 'Verified: Sending to F***' text. Invalid wallet shows red border and 'Wallet not found' error.

features_tested.details: Login with demo@trader.com/demo123 successful, redirects to trade page, then navigate to /ftc-mining shows mining page with Ultra Miner subscription active
Console shows continuous balance updates (354.08... → 354.09... etc.) every 50ms. FTC Mined Today counter increments in real-time.
Clicking 'Send FTC to Another User' button opens modal with balance display, recipient input, amount input, note field, and recent transfers list

features_tested.feature: Enter valid wallet address - shows green 'Verified' with masked recipient name
features_tested.details: Entering VPxDZRjxLQj4oMM6jaRNgVtvAp4DWiwy shows '✅ Verified: Sending to F***' in green text with green border on input

features_tested.feature: Enter invalid wallet address - shows red 'Wallet not found'
features_tested.details: Backend API returns {valid: false, message: 'Wallet address not found'}. Frontend shows red border. Note: Verification only triggers for addresses >= 20 characters.

features_tested.feature: Send FTC to valid wallet - transaction succeeds
features_tested.details: Sending 1 FTC to valid wallet shows 'Transaction confirmed on blockchain' toast with block number and confirmations
Balance decreased from 354.xx to 353.xx after sending 1 FTC. Backend wallet balance updated correctly.

features_tested.feature: Global FTC ledger shows the transaction
features_tested.details: Global Blockchain Ledger modal shows 'SEND | Send to Fita | by Demo Trader | 1.00 FTC (Fee: 0.0001)' with block number and confirmations
Clicking 'Refresh Mining Data' button syncs data from server. Balance updates to server value.
AI Boost button shows 'TAP FOR AI BOOST!' with '5s (2x speed)' text. Backend returns boost_duration: 5, boost_multiplier: 2.0

api_endpoints_verified.details: Returns success with transaction details including tx_hash, fee_amount, amount_received
Returns transactions array with FTC_TRANSFER entries showing sender, recipient, amount, fee, block_number
Activates 5s 2x boost when mining session is active
Returns fee_percent, fee_amount, amount_after_fee based on transaction amount
